overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session to conduct the library director's performance review, which is not a proper purpose; the Board had already cured, so no further action was ordered.

allegations.summary: The Board convened in executive session on June 12 to conduct the library director's annual performance review, which is not a proper executive session purpose.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges, and we find, that it improperly convened in executive session to conduct the library director’s performance review.

allegations.summary: The open session announcement before executive session allegedly failed to cite which of the ten executive session purposes the Board relied on.
allegations.key_passage: the Board could not have properly cited to any of the purposes.

allegations.summary: The complainant said the minutes of the improper executive session had not been released to the public.
allegations.key_passage: In response, the Board released the minutes in their entirety, sending a copy to the Complainant

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25); similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
